concept: Claude Code compaction floor of 100K versus small local windows
summary: The /autocompact command and --autocompact flag accept 100K to 1M; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW clamps lower values up to 100K.

facts.text: The /autocompact command and --autocompact flag accept 100K to 1M; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW clamps lower values up to 100K.
A value written with a suffix such as 500k is read as 500 and clamped to 100K, so a user trying 32k silently gets 100K.
Whether CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS below 100K is also clamped is still undocumented; the model-config page states the 100K to 1M range only for the auto-compact window.
The model-config page states the auto-compact window command and flag accept 100K to 1M tokens
CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW clamps values below 100000 up to 100K, including a suffixed value like 500k read as 500
No documented control sets the auto-compact window below 100K; the already-recorded levers are CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE and CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS
